results.title: IME composition commit
results.notes: Latency is compositionend timestamp to the render showing the commit; correct means one remote write per commit, none duplicated.

results.title: 5 simultaneous sessions
results.notes: Background sessions are opened xterm terminals in display:none panes, as App.tsx keeps inactive sessions; per-session figures are the JS-heap and resident-set growth after forced GC divided by sessions; xterm keeps its cell buffers in typed arrays, so RSS is the figure that includes them.
